### 【主谓一致】

### 【从句剖析】

2. **定语从句**：in which precipitation and other resources varied across the landscape。修饰先行词 environment。in which 相当于 where。

### 【代词指代】
it 指代 food；who 指代 ally。

### 【非谓语动词】
made by a distant ally：过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 pottery。相当于 who was made by... 的省略。
